objective: Restore signed-in Cluster members' dated Daily Bible reading while keeping forbidden low-level SQL function inaccessible and all account-isolated offline caches intact.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Main 5a97b754b6e0319690a717461bdd182b7b132b0c has 4 live direct reads of revoked get_automatic_bible_reading; Supabase prod observed 116 HTTP 403 events in 23h. Existing get_automatic_bible_today checks ACTIVE Cluster and trusted system admin; no native production OTA fingerprint assumed.
chosenApproach: Create a narrow authenticated dated-reading wrapper that invokes the canonical get_automatic_bible_today membership gate first, preserving lower-level function revocation, then update four client invocations.
selectionRationale: Fixes error without granting unrestricted RPC bypass to non-Cluster members; no change to reading assignments, chapter records, offline content authorization or points.
alternativeApproaches: GRANT authenticated to get_automatic_bible_reading(date): rejected because it skips Cluster gate.
Return today's reading for every requested date: rejected because it corrupts past/future assignment mapping.
Authorized dated wrapper with existing gate: selected.
acceptanceChecks: Engineering Accountability and Performance QA pass
No direct low-level grant for anon or signed-in users
Cluster user passes and non-member denied in authenticated RPC test
Dated reading output equals original mapping for eligible user
No change to media, ads, PTT, rewards or reading caches
preserveBehaviors: Cluster active membership required for Daily Reading, Devotion, Lessons
Dated assignments, reflection and offline account-bound cache preserved
No changes to video playback or native sound resources
releaseStatus: DEV PR until signed-off CI, backend function promotion and compatible OTA.
